decisionsTitle: Confirmarea minorilor din lista de voluntari
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11:** «as vrea sa pot confirma si voluntarele minore» — from the «Voluntari» list, where the organizers work the people. Amends §768 only in what the list shows.

**What was wrong.** §768 holds a volunteer under eighteen out of «Confirmă» until the parent or guardian has agreed (`VOLUNTEER_GUARDIAN_MISSING`), and gave the verbs for getting that agreement — «Trimite linkul părintelui», the sheet «PDF de semnat de părinte», «Acordul părintelui pe hârtie» — to the person's block alone. The list's row drew «Confirmă» for every row, so for a minor it was a button the server was known to refuse, and nothing on the row said why or what to do instead.

**The choice.** Not «let «Confirmă» work on a minor before the agreement» (that is the legal condition §768 set), but «put the parent's verbs on the row, where «Confirmă» was», so the organizer gets the agreement and confirms from the same list. The list's row of a minor whose parent has not agreed wears the person's block's own chip — «Acordul părintelui lipsește», or «Link trimis părintelui» — and, in place of «Confirmă», the block's own verbs, each asking first with its own question and posting to the card's own Server Actions, back to the same list address (`returnTo`: filters, sort and page kept) with the existing toast or refusal. «Anulează» stays; an adult's row and the row of a minor whose parent agreed are as before, and after the paper record «Confirmă» is drawn on the same row and works.

**One decision, two screens.** The condition is not written twice. `guardianAskOf` (`domain/volunteer.ts`) says what a row is offered — nothing (an adult, a parent who agreed, a cancelled person), the missing name, the closed gate, or the verbs with whether the link can go — and `guardianAllowsConfirm`, which the server already used, says when «Confirmă» is drawn. `guardianChips` and `GuardianVerbs` (`ui/VolunteerPerson.tsx`) draw the chip and the verbs, for the block and for the row alike. The link's button is drawn only with both addresses (the volunteer's and the parent's), else the block's own sentence; nothing is drawn while the privacy notice or the agreement in force does not describe minors (`volunteerMinorsOpen`) — never a button the server is known to refuse. The sheet is drawn beside the paper button: it has to be printed before it can be signed, and what the paper press posts is the version and the roles that sheet prints (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_REPRINT` as before).

**A minor with no parent's name** (a row the club typed) says so in one plain sentence — «Numele părintelui lipsește…» — with a link to the person's page, where «Modifică» takes it; no link, sheet or paper record can name nobody.

**No query per row.** The rows already carry the age, the parent's name and address, when a link was sent and whether the parent agreed (`volunteerItemsOf`). The page reads `volunteerMinorsOpen` and the agreement in force in each language once, and only when a row of the page waits on a parent.

**Refused.** Confirming a minor before the agreement — from the list or by a forged post (`VOLUNTEER_GUARDIAN_MISSING` as before, and nothing written); a new verb, audit action or migration; any change to a legal text or template; a second copy of the condition in the list; a «Confirmă» that the server would refuse, drawn and answered with an error.

**Words.** The block's own keys under `Admin.volunteers.guardian.*`; two new ones for the missing name, in both catalogues.
changelogLine: - **A minor's parent from the «Voluntari» list.** A volunteer under eighteen whose parent has not agreed wears «Acordul părintelui lipsește» on the list and gets, in place of «Confirmă», the person's own verbs — «Trimite linkul părintelui», «PDF de semnat de părinte», «Acordul părintelui pe hârtie» — so the organizer records the agreement and then confirms, without leaving the list; the server's rule is unchanged. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given `/admin/volunteers` and a volunteer under eighteen whose parent or guardian has not agreed, then each of the row's two copies wears the person's block's chip («Acordul părintelui lipsește», or «Link trimis părintelui» while a link is live) and draws no «Confirmă» but the block's own verbs under the block's own conditions (`guardianAskOf`): «Trimite linkul părintelui» / «Trimite din nou linkul părintelui» only with the volunteer's and the parent's addresses, the link «PDF de semnat de părinte» and «Acordul părintelui pe hârtie» with their questions, nothing while the notice or the agreement in force does not describe minors, and, for a row with no parent's name, one sentence and a link to the person's page; «Anulează» stays, an adult's row and the row of a minor whose parent agreed are as before, each press comes back to the list's own address through `returnTo`, and the list reads its rows in one query (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a minor's row on the list, when the Organizer records the parent's paper agreement from it, then «Confirmă» is drawn on the same row and confirms the volunteer; a forged «Confirmă» before the agreement is refused with `VOLUNTEER_GUARDIAN_MISSING` and writes nothing, and the verbs refuse a role that may not manage volunteers (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
